author: Christiansavard

title: A tour with history, culture, and passion.
text: This tour more than exceeded our expectations. Our bus driver, Marc, and our tour guide Laura were exceptional. Laura was great at her communication skills as she interacted with the entire group all the time. She showed exceptional passion for her culture and history ofthe monastery. I would highly recommend to anyone this tour and by the way be sure to request Laura.
author: cliffc399

title: Great experience
text: Fantastic tour. Early start - which was great because of how busy Montserrat gets in the late morning. The cog wheel train up to the monastery was worth it compared to other tours, you got much better views than the roadside. Once up on the mountain our tour guide was great, spoke great English and was very nice and helpful. We had plenty of free time after the guided tour to go further up the mountain on the cable car for the above view. We enjoyed the liquor tasting and got some cheese from local vendors! Fantastic trip - highly recommend!
author: mitchellcA7530WF

title: Great morning at the Montserrat
